title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
abstract: QLoRA freezes a quantized pretrained model and trains low-rank adapters. NF4, double quantization and paged optimizers reduce training memory. Reported results concern the architectures and datasets studied in the paper, and do not establish Qwen3.5 quality.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
abstract: Combines parametric generation with retrieved non-parametric knowledge. The paper evaluates dense Wikipedia retrieval and seq2seq generation; this local experiment uses a small path-pattern registry rather than reproducing that retrieval system.

title: Qwen3.5 Fine-tuning Guide
abstract: The guide estimates BF16 LoRA memory of 10GB for 4B and 22GB for 9B, requires Transformers5, and cautions against Qwen3.5 QLoRA because of quantization differences. Therefore the proposed 8GB NF4 run is an empirical feasibility probe.

title: Bitsandbytes quantization
abstract: Documents quantized linear layers, NF4 and nested quantization; quantized training is limited to additional parameters.

title: Qwen3.5-4B
abstract: Public instruction checkpoint with a language model and vision encoder. This experiment uses text inputs and a frozen language base with attention adapters.

title: Gemma4 E4B instruction QAT Q4_0 GGUF
abstract: Official quantization-aware-trained GGUF checkpoint. Effective parameter naming does not imply the same footprint as an ordinary4B checkpoint; text GGUF is5154941280bytes and vision projection is not used here.
